data.comment:
# Comfy Eleven v4- Text to Dialogue

Generate a multi-speaker dialogue from text with Eleven v4: give every entry its own line and its own voice, direct the delivery with audio tags such as [quietly] or [laughs], or clone a voice from a sample and let it take a turn. One audio file is output. Ideal for podcasts, game dialogue, and character conversations.
 Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_elevenlabs_v4_text_to_dialogue.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.inputs.text1: [quietly, close to the mic] I ran the numbers twice... the engine is holding steady. Wait, why is the alarm light-
data.inputs.text2: [sighs, then firmly] Then stop smiling and seal the hatch. [urgent] I need the console live before the countdown hits twenty.
